integrity: Chain models, finite-field lower bounds, rational-rank matching argument, signed traces and character decomposition are documented with a standalone verifier; no independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Determines only rational homology and its S5 character for exactly three unordered particles; does not determine integral torsion. Earlier nonequivariant Petersen-family data may include Betti numbers; priority for equivalent equivariant formulas remains subject to further bibliographical checking.
title: The full symmetric-group homology character of three unordered particles on the Petersen graph
